「一键扫描」会实际调用 wsl.exe 列出 WSL 发行版，故放在按钮后面而不: Scan now actually runs wsl.exe to list WSL distros, which is why it sits behind the button instead of at startup; the results appear in the {side} Local Terminal group and one click opens that terminal.
上传到远端当前目录（需连上 SSH 并打开远端文件页）: Upload to Remote Folder (needs a live SSH tab with its file page open)
下载到本机面板（先在「本机」页打开一个目录）: Download to This PC Folder (open a folder on the This PC page first)
主密码只用于派生库密钥，不会写入任何文件；忘记主密码将无法恢复数据。每次启动需输: The master password only derives the vault key and is never written to any file; if you forget it the data cannot be recovered. Enter it at every launch — the vault file can be carried to another machine and unlocked with it.
主题切换立即生效并写入凭据库，下次启动沿用。: Theme changes apply immediately and are stored in the vault for the next launch.
便携模式首次使用：设置主密码以创建加密库。密码仅用于派生库密钥，不会保存到任何地: First run in portable mode: set a master password to create the encrypted vault. It is used only to derive the vault key and is stored nowhere — lose it and the data is unrecoverable, so keep it safe.
数据位于程序目录的 data 文件夹；复制程序与 data 文件夹即可迁移。: Data is stored in the data folder beside the application; copy both the app and this folder to move it.
启用后会将加密凭据库复制到程序目录的 data 文件夹，应用随后自动退出；重新启: This copies the encrypted vault to the data folder beside the application, then exits. Restart the app to switch modes; the original data is kept.
迁移并退出: Move to portable mode and exit
凭据库未解锁，无法设置或更换主密码。: The vault is locked, so the master password cannot be set or changed.
勾选底部状态栏要显示的条目，取消勾选即隐藏；改动立即生效并写入凭据库。: Tick the entries to show in the status bar; untick to hide. Changes apply immediately and are stored in the vault.
单击切换 · 双击重命名 · 中键关闭: Click to switch · double-click to rename · middle-click to close
名称不能包含 / 或 \\，也不能是 . 或 ..。: Names cannot contain / or \, and cannot be . or ..
回滚行数（滚动到历史时出现）: Scrollback lines (shown when scrolled into history)
在本机 127.0.0.1 上提供 SOCKS5 代理（无认证），目标地址由客户: Serves a SOCKS5 proxy (no authentication) on local 127.0.0.1; target addresses come from the client request and are resolved by the server.
填写地址后按回车或点「连接」: Fill in the address, then press Enter or click Connect
密码只在本次连接的内存里使用，不会保存: The password is used only in memory for this connection and is never saved
保存主机只记地址与用户名；密码只在本次连接的内存里使用: Saving a host keeps only the address and username; the password stays in memory for this connection
保存主机时填写的密码会加密存入凭据库；不点保存则只在本次连接使用: A password entered when saving is encrypted into the credential vault; without saving it is used only for this connection
导航栏始终贴在窗口外缘: The rail always stays on the outer edge of the window
已向上滚动 {lines} 行，到底部时不再显示: Scrolled {lines} lines up; hidden once you reach the bottom
已经在根目录（换盘请在路径栏输入盘符）: Already at the root (type a drive letter in the path bar to switch drives)
已释放键盘，点击画面可重新捕获: Keyboard released — click the screen to capture again
当前由系统凭据管理器免密解锁，开箱即用。建议设置主密码：库文件可凭口令带往其他机: Right now the vault unlocks without a password through the system credential manager. Setting a master password is recommended: the vault file can then travel to another machine, anyone holding only the file still cannot read it, and losing the password means losing the data.
必须带 Ctrl 或 Alt（或用 F1–F12）: Must include Ctrl or Alt (or use F1–F12)
把断开原因原文复制到剪贴板，方便贴给别人排查: Copies the raw disconnect reason to the clipboard, handy when pasting it for someone to triage
把本地剪贴板文本发送到远端: Send local clipboard text to the remote
按键正在同步到所有会话，点击关闭: Keys are syncing to every session — click to stop
捕获后按键直接送给远端，按 Esc 释放: When captured, keys go straight to the remote; press Esc to release
文件将被永久删除，此操作不可撤销。: The file will be deleted permanently; this cannot be undone.
文件里没有可导入的键宏: The file contains no importable macros
显示隐藏文件（点开切换，选择会记住）: Show hidden files (click to toggle, choice is saved)
暂无保存的规则，点下方「设置…」添加一条。: No saved rules yet — click Settings… below to add one.
服务器只监听其 127.0.0.1，不对公网开放；目标地址按本机视角解析。: The server listens only on its own 127.0.0.1 and is not exposed publicly; target addresses are resolved from the local point of view.
本地终端没有远端文件可浏览: A local terminal has no remote files to browse
查找终端内容…（回车下一个，Shift+回车上一个）: Find in terminal… (Enter for next, Shift+Enter for previous)
格式不对：应为 ctrl-alt-1 这样的组合键: Invalid format: use a combination such as ctrl-alt-1
正在新建加密库并全量搬迁，请稍候…: Creating the encrypted vault and migrating everything…
没有可执行键宏的活动会话: No active session to run the macro in
没有打开的转发配置: No open connection to forward through
添加或修改转发规则: Add or edit a forwarding rule
点击画面捕获键盘，Esc 释放: Click the screen to capture the keyboard; Esc releases it
点击编辑路径，回车跳转（可直接输入 D:\\ 换盘）: Click to edit the path, Enter to jump (type D:\ to switch drives)
监听只绑本机 127.0.0.1，不对局域网开放；目标地址按服务器视角解析。: The listener binds only to local 127.0.0.1 and is not open to the network; target addresses are resolved from the server's point of view.
目录必须为空才能删除；此操作不可撤销。: The directory has to be empty to be deleted; this cannot be undone.
私钥口令（可选，留空则连接时按需询问）: Key passphrase (optional; asked on connect when left empty)
立即生效；菜单与面板即刻改用该语言: Applies immediately; menus and panels switch to this language at once
组合键触发一段固定输入；发送走当前活动会话的写入通道。: A key combination sends a fixed sequence of input through the active session's write channel.
终端外观只影响会话终端（界面主题在「外观」分页里），改动立即生效并写入凭据库。: Terminal appearance affects session terminals only (the UI theme lives in the Appearance tab). Changes apply immediately and are stored in the vault.
终端状态（读自活动终端，本地终端与远程会话都适用）: Terminal status (read from the active terminal; applies to local and remote sessions)
自动重连已停止，按回车手动重连: Auto-reconnect stopped — press Enter to reconnect manually
至少要填一步发送内容: At least one step must send something
要发送到所有会话的命令（回车在远端执行）: Command to send to every session (Enter runs it on the remote)
触发键需带 Ctrl / Alt（或 F1–F12）；终端未聚焦时不会触发。: Triggers must include Ctrl / Alt (or be F1–F12); they fire only while a terminal has focus.
触发键（点一下再按下组合键，× 清空＝不绑键）: Trigger (click it, then press the chord; × clears = no binding)
该组合已被应用或终端占用: That combination is already taken by the app or the terminal
该触发键已被其它键宏占用: That trigger is already used by another macro
请从左侧重新点击该主机连接: Click this host in the left-hand list to connect again
超时覆盖 DNS、TCP、握手、认证与开启 shell 的全过程；超时即结束本次: The timeout covers DNS, TCP, the handshake, authentication and opening the shell; when it expires the attempt ends with Connection timed out.
跟随终端：开（点击关闭）: Following the terminal: on (click to turn off)
转义：\\n 回车 · \\t Tab · \\e ESC · \\\\ 反斜杠: Escapes: \n Enter · \t Tab · \e ESC · \\ backslash; anything else is sent literally.
转发规则绑定当前 SSH 会话，保存后用开关即时启停: Forwarding rules bind to the current SSH session; after saving, the switch starts or stops them immediately
输入 #RGB 或 #RRGGBB，回车前即生效；格式不合法时保持上一个有效颜色: Enter #RGB or #RRGGBB — it takes effect before you press Enter, and an invalid value keeps the last valid color.
输入主密码解锁凭据库: Enter the master password to unlock the vault
输入主密码解锁凭据库（库文件与密码均不离开本机/本目录）。: Enter the master password to unlock the vault (neither the vault file nor the password leaves this machine or folder).
还没有连接记录，从左侧主机列表选一台即可开始: No connections yet — pick a host from the list on the left to start
还没有键宏。点「新建宏」录入一条，或从 JSON 文件导入。: No macros yet. Click "New macro" to add one, or import a JSON file.
远程主机信息（连接后经 exec 探测取得，远端没探到的项自动不显示）: Remote host info (probed via exec after connecting; anything the remote cannot provide is hidden)
远程桌面：请填写主机地址: Remote desktop: enter a host address
请输入远程桌面密码后连接: Enter the remote desktop password to connect
密码会加密保存到凭据库，下次点该主机直接复用；留空表示不带密码: The password is encrypted into the credential vault and reused next time you open this host; leave it blank to connect without one
密码只在本次连接的内存里使用；留空表示不带密码: The password stays in memory for this connection only; leave it blank to connect without one
认证失败：请重新输入密码后重试（可留空再试）: Authentication failed: enter the password again and retry (or leave it blank and retry)
VNC 认证失败：请检查密码后重试: VNC authentication failed: check the password and retry
远程终端会话管理器 · SSH / Telnet / 本地终端: Remote terminal session manager · SSH / Telnet / local terminals
连接意外中断（断网、服务端掉线）后自动重建 SSH 会话；远端主动 exit 不: An SSH session is rebuilt automatically after an unexpected drop (network loss, server going away); a remote exit does not trigger auto-reconnect.
锁定凭据库（需主密码解锁）: Lock vault (unlocking needs the master password)
首次连接就失败（地址写错、端口不通）不自动重试；断线后最多连续重试 {max}: A first connection that fails outright (wrong address, unreachable port) is not retried; after a drop there are at most {max} consecutive retries with 1 / 2 / 5 / 10 / 20 second backoff, and the counter resets once the session has run steadily for 30 seconds. While waiting you can cancel in the banner or press Enter to reconnect now.
网络诊断：主机名含不支持的字符: Network diagnostics: the host name contains unsupported characters
开启后关闭窗口会隐藏到托盘，会话在后台保活；关闭（默认）则关窗直接退出。运行中关: When enabled, closing the window hides it to the tray and keeps sessions alive in the background; when disabled (default) closing quits. Turning it off at runtime leaves the icon until the next launch.
已启用系统托盘：关闭窗口将隐藏到托盘: System tray enabled: closing the window will hide it to the tray
已关闭系统托盘：之后关窗直接退出，图标在下次启动时完全移除: System tray disabled: closing now quits, and the icon is fully removed on the next launch
共 {count} 台主机，点服务按钮直接打开: {count} hosts found — click a service button to open
扫描本机各网段，探测 SSH / Telnet / RDP / VNC: Scans this machine's subnets for SSH / Telnet / RDP / VNC
未发现开放 22 / 23 / 3389 / 5900 的主机: No hosts with 22 / 23 / 3389 / 5900 open were found
已填入发现的地址，填写凭据后点「连接」: Address filled in from discovery; enter credentials and click Connect
已填入主机信息，输入密码后点「连接」: Host details filled in; enter the password and click Connect
RDP 认证失败：请检查用户名、域和密码后重试: RDP authentication failed: check the username, domain and password, then retry
RDP 剪贴板已随系统自动同步，直接在远端按 Ctrl+V 即可（文件也可直接粘: The RDP clipboard syncs via the system clipboard automatically — press Ctrl+V on the remote (files can be pasted too)
RDP 剪贴板随系统自动同步（文本与文件），直接 Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V: The RDP clipboard syncs via the system clipboard automatically (text and files); use Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V directly
远程桌面还没连上：连上后再拖入文件: The remote desktop isn't connected yet; drop files after it connects
VNC 协议没有文件传输能力：需要传文件请改用 RDP 连接: VNC has no file transfer capability: use an RDP connection to send files
已把 {count} 个文件放进剪贴板并在远端粘贴到当前文件夹；没反应时在远端按: Put {count} file(s) on the clipboard and pasted them into the remote's current folder; press Ctrl+V there if nothing happened
文件粘贴未开始：远端没有接收文件列表，可在远端手动按 Ctrl+V: Paste did not start: the remote never accepted the file list; press Ctrl+V there manually
文件粘贴未开始（本机剪贴板被占用或远端未接收文件列表），可稍后重试；远端内容就绪: Paste did not start (the local clipboard was busy or the remote didn't accept the file list); retry later, or press Ctrl+V on the remote once its clipboard is ready
远端还没开始接收：若弹出了同名文件覆盖确认，请在那个窗口里选「替换」，或先删掉远: The remote hasn't started receiving yet: if a same-name overwrite prompt appeared, choose Replace in that window, or delete the remote file with the same name first
让远端把桌面分辨率调整为当前窗口大小: Ask the remote to resize its desktop to this window
是否要将此文件上传回服务器？: Do you want to upload this file back to the server?
保存常用命令，按需插入或直接执行到当前会话。: Keep frequently used commands ready to insert or run in the active session.
还没有命令片段。点「新建片段」添加一条。: No snippets yet. Click "New snippet" to add one.
片段名称过长（最多 80 个字符）: Snippet name is too long (80 characters max)
命令内容包含无法发送的字符: Command contains characters that cannot be sent
命令内容过长（最多 16 KB）: Command is too long (16 KB max)
插入到当前会话（不追加回车）: Insert into the active session (no Enter)
发送到当前会话并回车: Send to the active session and press Enter
没有可发送命令片段的终端会话: No terminal session to send the snippet to
会话已断开，无法发送命令片段: Session disconnected; cannot send the snippet
片段保存在加密库；「执行」会自动追加回车。: Snippets are stored in the encrypted vault; Run appends Enter.
单行命令；内容按字面发送，不做变量替换。: Single-line commands only; sent literally without variable substitution.
备注用于搜索，不会发送: Notes are searchable and never sent
输入命令时自动弹出片段候选：↑↓ 选择、Tab / Enter 补全、Esc 关: Show snippet candidates while typing: ↑↓ to select, Tab / Enter to complete, Esc to dismiss. Completion only replaces the current word and never runs the command. When off, keystrokes go straight to the shell.
内置命令只读；可切换平台查看，补全只提示当前会话平台的命令。需要固定参数时点「存: Built-in commands are read-only. Switch platforms above to browse them; completion only suggests commands for the session's platform. Click "Save to my snippets" to adjust arguments.
更新软件包索引并升级已安装的软件: Refresh package lists and upgrade installed packages
把 <包名> 换成要安装的软件，回车前可再确认: Replace <package> with the package name and confirm before pressing Enter
当前目录下占用最大的前 20 项: Top 20 items by size in the current directory
内存概览与占用最高的进程: Memory overview and the top processes by memory
列出 TCP 监听端口和对应进程: List TCP listening ports and their processes
查看服务是否在运行: Check whether a service is running
修改配置后重启服务: Restart a service after changing its configuration
实时跟踪服务日志，Ctrl+C 退出: Follow service logs live; press Ctrl+C to exit
发 4 个包测试外网连通性: Send 4 packets to test Internet connectivity
各网卡的 IPv4 / IPv6 地址: IPv4 / IPv6 addresses of each interface
从根目录按名称查找文件: Search for a file by name starting at /
系统名称、版本与上次启动时间: OS name, version and last boot time
TCP 监听端口与对应进程 ID: TCP listening ports and owning process IDs
从 C 盘按名称递归查找，权限错误自动忽略: Search drive C recursively by name, ignoring access errors
把 URL 下载到当前目录: Download a URL into the current directory
按名称排序的全部环境变量: All environment variables, sorted by name
读取卸载注册表项，只含系统级安装: Reads uninstall registry keys; system-wide installs only
实时跟踪日志，Ctrl+C 退出: Follow logs live; press Ctrl+C to exit
以 sh 进入容器，没有 sh 时换成 bash: Enter with sh; use bash if sh is unavailable
删除已停止容器、悬空镜像与未使用网络（有数据卷的容器不受影响）: Remove stopped containers, dangling images and unused networks (containers with volumes are kept)
只记录终端回显过的命令行，密码输入不会被记录；共 {count} 条，新的在前。: Only commands echoed by the terminal are recorded; password input never is. {count} entries, newest first.
「执行」会自动追加回车；历史随加密库保存。: "Run" appends Enter; history is stored in the encrypted vault.
还没有命令历史。在终端里执行命令后会自动记录。: No command history yet. Commands you run in a terminal are recorded automatically.
没有可发送命令的终端会话: No terminal session to send the command to
会话已断开，无法发送命令: Session disconnected; cannot send the command
